goal: Enhance Today's Run with a prominent Coaching Intelligence Card that synthesizes ACWR state, VDOT trend, and recent load into a single glanceable 'today's guidance' answer (run/rest/easy), making the Daily Opening Test passable within 10 seconds
runtimeProof: Vite build completed in 1.06s with no errors. eslint clean. No new warnings. TodayRun chunk 27.39 kB.
risks: Coaching intelligence strip is a new UI section that exists above the hero. On mobile (520px), it stacks as a single column. On tablet (1080px), it's 2 columns. On desktop, 4 columns.

The coaching intelligence strip relies on existing data: recommendation.type, vdotTrend, metrics.acwr, and shoeRecommendation. No new backend endpoints were needed.

Keep the i18n keys in the today_run namespace for the coaching intelligence strings

mergeNotes: No file conflicts expected — all changes are additive (new JSX section, new i18n keys, new CSS). The existing hero section and metrics panel are untouched.
